channel.title: Date the war: daily reel
channel.description: Each day's sourced events on the globe, as a flyover. Entries marked auto were drafted by a daily job and have not been reviewed.

item.title: 2026-09-08: 21 sourced events
item.description: Houthi attacks hit Saudi cities and energy facilities · Russian strikes resume after temporary pause for U.S. envoys · Canada imposes retaliatory tariffs up to 50 percent on US goods · Israeli strikes destroy homes and displace families in Gaza · Russian drone strike on Kyiv TV building kills five · Haiti assessment documents large-scale displacement and hunger · Saudi Arabia vows retaliation after Houthi strikes on cities · Sudan's healthcare system nears collapse amid war and aid cuts · UK sanctions Israeli settlement goods; Israel shuts UK consulate · UK pledges winter air defence package to Ukraine · Yemen's reignited war drives new wave of child recruitment · Yemen's civil war reignites around Sanaa and Red Sea · France announces planned restrictions on settlement products · Germany announces additional Patriot interceptors for Ukraine · U.S. expands sanctions targeting Iranian aviation networks · U.S. explores wider access to Venezuelan minerals · Ukraine reports promising ideas from renewed U.S. mediation · US declines to join UK ban on Israeli settlement trade · Oil rises after Saudi energy-site attacks · UNCTAD warns Hormuz disruption threatens smaller businesses · EU condemns Serbian ministers over a war criminal's funeral
